issue.detail: prev_in updates during reset cycles, so a 1 sampled while reset is high followed by 0 after release captures on the first released edge; spec does not say whether reset-cycle history should count.
issue.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issue.alternative: Clear/ignore prev_in while reset is high so a 1 sampled only during reset does not cause capture after release; sequence gives contract out=1 on second edge, alternative out=0.
